materials_and_labels: q rows[1,0] and[0,1]; k rows[1,0],[0,1],[1,1]. q.shape=(2,2); k.T.shape=(2,3). scores row indexes query, column indexes candidate. assert checks2×3 shape.
expected_change: I expect an explanation of each score row and of independent per-query normalization; no parameter update or content retrieval has occurred.
confusion_and_quote: No new ambiguity.「scores = q @ k.T」uses the3.2 row-to-key dot product for every query. These cards are now directly specified, not outputs of implemented learned transforms.
missing_visuals: No missing figure for these six scalar comparisons; rows and column counts are small and explicit.
